---
title: "TrailPulse — Local Trail Conditions"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r setup}
source("R/setup.R")
library(yaml)
library(glue)
library(purrr)

all_parks <- yaml::read_yaml("data/parks.yml")[["parks"]]
```

> **Updated daily.** Conditions are estimated from weather data and soil moisture models — not a substitute for official trail closures.

```{r park-cards}
#| output: asis

card_html <- purrr::map_chr(all_parks, function(p) {
  park_url <- paste0("parks/", p$id, "/index.html")
  card_img <- paste0("parks/", p$id, "/og-card.png")

  glue::glue(
    '<a href="{park_url}" class="tp-park-card" style="text-decoration:none;color:inherit;display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);">',
    '<img src="{card_img}" alt="{p$name} trail conditions card" style="width:100%;display:block;">',
    '<div style="padding:0.6rem 0.9rem 0.7rem;">',
    '<div style="font-weight:600;font-size:1rem;">{p$name}</div>',
    '<div style="font-size:0.85em;color:#666;">{p$location}</div>',
    '</div>',
    '</a>',
    .sep = "\n"
  )
})

cat('<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(340px,1fr));gap:1.25rem;margin-top:1.5rem;">\n')
cat(paste(card_html, collapse = "\n"))
cat('\n</div>\n')
```

---

*Trail condition data sourced from [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com), [USGS National Water Information System](https://waterdata.usgs.gov), and [NWS](https://www.weather.gov). Not affiliated with Erie County Parks or any land management authority.*
